description: Read public live chat from videos, live streams or channels. No cookies, login or proxy setup required.

channelDiscoveryMode.description: Which streams to pick from each channel. Used with channel references.
channelDiscoveryMode.title: Channel discovery

channelRefs.description: Channel handles (@name), channel URLs or UC… channel IDs. The actor discovers current live streams and recent stream replays from each channel.
channelRefs.title: Channels

endOffsetSecs.description: Replay only. Stop after this video offset. Use 0 to read to the end.
endOffsetSecs.title: End offset (seconds)

includeGiftEvents.description: Include gift membership purchases, gift membership redemptions and paid gift messages.
includeGiftEvents.title: Include gifts

includeMembershipEvents.description: Include new and renewed channel membership events.
includeMembershipEvents.title: Include memberships

includeMetadata.description: Repeat video and stream metadata on each chat row.
includeMetadata.title: Include stream metadata

includePlaceholders.description: Include raw placeholder rows that contain only an ID and timestamp.
includePlaceholders.title: Include placeholders

includeSummary.description: Add one stream_summary row per video with event counts, per-currency totals, top supporters and completeness.
includeSummary.title: Include stream summary

includeSuperChats.description: Include paid Super Chat messages and paid Super Stickers.
includeSuperChats.title: Include Super Chats and Stickers

includeSystemEvents.description: Include engagement notices, slow-mode changes, restricted participation and other system rows.
includeSystemEvents.title: Include system events

includeUpcomingLives.description: Emit an upcoming status row for scheduled channel streams instead of skipping them.
includeUpcomingLives.title: Include upcoming streams

language.description: Interface language used when requesting YouTube pages and chat.
language.title: Language

liveCollectSecs.description: How long to keep polling an active chat before stopping. Live captures are always partial.
liveCollectSecs.title: Live capture seconds

lookbackDays.description: How far back to include ended streams from a channel. Use 0 for no limit.
lookbackDays.title: Replay lookback days

maxMessagesPerVideo.description: Maximum unique chat events collected from each video. Use 0 to collect every available event.
maxMessagesPerVideo.title: Messages per video

maxTimePerVideoSecs.description: Safety limit for replay pagination on one video, in seconds. A run that reaches it reports partial_capture.
maxTimePerVideoSecs.title: Time budget per video

maxTotalItems.description: Whole-run cap across all videos and summary rows. Use 0 for no limit.
maxTotalItems.title: Maximum dataset items

maxVideosPerChannel.description: Maximum streams to process from each channel.
maxVideosPerChannel.title: Videos per channel

mode.description: Auto detects live versus replay. Active captures an ongoing live chat. Replay reads the saved chat of an ended stream.
mode.title: Chat mode

pollIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay between live chat polls. YouTube's own timeout is honoured when it is longer.
pollIntervalMs.title: Live poll interval (ms)

regionCode.description: Region used for YouTube page and chat requests.
regionCode.title: Region

startOffsetSecs.description: Replay only. Skip events before this video offset. Use 0 to start at the beginning.
startOffsetSecs.title: Start offset (seconds)

videoRefs.description: YouTube watch, live, shorts or youtu.be links, 11-character video IDs, or a channel live link such as @handle/live.
videoRefs.title: Video URLs or IDs

title: YouTube Live Chat Input
